decisions.rationale: Human review is not certain; suitability depends on the situation.
decisions.limitations: A dominant color may be appropriate in some designs, but a dominant or single theme color is not a general personal preference rule.

decisions.rationale: Human review is neutral; current mainstream-level impact is enough.
decisions.limitations: Controlled high impact can be good when appropriate, but unusually strong transient impact is not itself a required preference.

decisions.rationale: Human review says section contrast depends on the situation and song.
decisions.limitations: Do not require large Verse/Chorus/Drop differences in every song.

decisions.rationale: Human review is uncertain; whether to reduce energy between peaks depends on the song.
decisions.limitations: Restraint between peaks is useful in some contexts, not a universal pattern.

decisions.rationale: Human review says buildup depends on fixture quantity/resources and the song.
decisions.limitations: This is both song-context-dependent and resource-dependent; not every buildup must add layers.

decisions.rationale: Human review confirms preference for a coherent designed whole-song energy arc.
decisions.limitations: Does not prescribe a fixed A-to-B-to-C formula; valid arcs may rise, fall, reset, plateau, delay a peak or contain multiple peaks.

decisions.rationale: Human review says geometry depends on the situation and has no fixed requirement.
decisions.limitations: Do not require symmetry, beam geometry or spatial patterns in every look.

decisions.rationale: Human review confirms this is very important: low, medium and high states should each function as intentional complete looks.
decisions.limitations: A low-energy look is not merely a high-energy look dimmed; relevant choices may include layers, focus, palette, density, spatial use, movement/effect and negative space, depending on context.
